title: Projected Distillation: On Learning to Solve Hard Problems from Close, Correct Targets
abstract: arXiv:2610.27467v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities. On hard problems, however, on-policy RL provides no reward-based learning signal when all attempts fail. On-policy distillation provides next-token supervision from a teacher, but on hard problems, if a rollout goes wrong early, subsequent supervision is conditioned on prefixes that already contain the mistake. Correct behavior can instead come from a gold or teacher solution, but such off-policy targets can differ substantially from the model's generations and, as we show, may erode existing capabilities. We therefore treat on-policyness as a continuum and propose projected distillation, which minimally edits the student's failed attempts into correct targets. translated_title: 投影蒸馏：从接近且正确的目标中学习解决困难问题
translated_abstract: 同策略学习是后训练的核心：在模型自身生成的样本上进行训练可以限制分布偏移，并有助于保留已有能力。然而在困难问题上，当所有尝试都失败时，同策略强化学习无法提供基于奖励的学习信号。同策略蒸馏可以提供来自教师的下一个词元（next-token）监督，但在困难问题上，如果一次 rollout 在早期就出错，后续监督将基于已经包含错误的前缀进行。正确的行为也可以来自标准答案或教师给出的解答，但这种离策略目标可能与模型自身的生成结果差异很大，并且正如我们所展示的，可能会侵蚀模型已有的能力。因此，我们将“同策略性”视为一个连续谱，并提出投影蒸馏方法，该方法将学生模型失败的尝试进行最小化的编辑，使其成为正确的目标。该方法使用对比性更新，使模型更倾向于采纳修正而非失败的尝试，并随着学生……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出“投影蒸馏”方法，将学生模型失败的尝试最小化地编辑成接近且正确的目标，并利用对比更新使模型优先学习修正版本，从而在困难问题上获得有效学习信号，同时保留已有能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes projected distillation, which minimally edits the student's failed attempts into close, correct targets and uses contrastive updates to prefer corrections, enabling learning on hard problems while preserving existing capabilities.
